competitor.name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.
competitor.description: One of the world's largest insurance brokerage, risk management, and consulting firms, known for high acquisition volume.

items.title: Gallagher Announces Agreement to Acquire Eastern Commercial Brokerage Group
items.summary: Gallagher signed definitive deal to acquire Pennsylvania-based commercial brokerage network with $42M annual revenue across manufacturing and logistics.

items.title: Gallagher Expands Midwest Public Entity Practice with Municipal Deal
items.summary: Acquired specialized municipal risk consultancy managing self-insurance pools for 60 Midwestern school districts and townships.

items.title: Gallagher Launches Gallagher CORE Specialty Placement Facility
items.summary: Unveiled Gallagher CORE, a wholesale and retail co-placement facility dedicated to hard-to-place casualty and habitational real estate risks.

items.title: Gallagher Promotes David Kroll to Regional Managing Director
items.summary: David Kroll elevated to manage commercial brokerage operations across the Mid-Atlantic, prioritizing M&A integration across 14 acquired agencies.

items.title: Gallagher Completes Acquisition of Texas Energy Specialty Broker
items.summary: Finalized purchase of Houston-based energy broker specializing in upstream oilfield contractor liabilities and environmental impairment.

items.title: Gallagher Market Update Notes Hardening Excess Liability Renewals
items.summary: Gallagher's quarterly market report observed 15% rate increases on corporate umbrella layers exceeding $25M due to nuclear verdicts.

battlecard_template.headline: Relentless M&A Engine Expanding Regional Commercial Density
battlecard_template.subtext: Gallagher maintains industry-leading acquisition cadence, rolling up regional middle-market agencies and cross-selling RPS wholesale capacity.

wins.title: Account Retention During Post-Merger Turmoil
wins.text: Target accounts of recently acquired Gallagher agencies where staff turnover and systems integration cause client communication lags.

wins.title: Transparent Retail Wholesale Separation
wins.text: Expose potential conflict of interest between Gallagher's retail arm and internal wholesale broker (Risk Placement Services).

wins.title: Tailored High-Touch Risk Control
wins.text: Differentiate with customized on-site safety programs rather than standardized Gallagher compliance templates.

moves.summary: Signed definitive agreement to acquire Eastern Commercial Brokerage Group ($42M revenue).
Acquired specialized municipal risk consultancy managing school district pools in Midwest.
Launched Gallagher CORE facility for hard-to-place casualty and habitational real estate.
